cards.whyItMatters: 对量化研究而言，它提示曲面编译的抽样方案需与下游目标函数对齐，否则会系统性放大误差；同时给出预测能力的谨慎边界——复杂序列模型未必优于简单线性基准，评估时需考虑聚类效应。
cards.summary: 研究整合有限总体抽样、温度化逆概率序列学习与因果活动时钟，在一块拆股调整后的NVDA股票与期权面板上做曲面重建和预测评估。结果显示：抽样设计与目标函数的匹配决定截面精度；预测方面短期价格难以超越带漂移随机游走，远期IV的均值回复仅在少数冲击后反转时段显现且不显著。作者将活动时钟视为稳定采样节奏的工具，但相关判断仍属描述性证据。
cards.limitations: 证据仅来自单一标的（拆股调整后的NVDA）2018至2025年面板，结论外推至其他资产或市场需谨慎。远期IV的均值回复在按交易时段聚类检验下不显著，序列模型未超越线性基准，因此预测能力结论应视为描述性而非确证。PPS相对简单随机抽样的增量预测收益未被建立。
cards.description: 该研究以NVDA股票与期权面板为对象，比较分层抽样与流动性加权PPS抽样在隐含波动率曲面重建中的误差表现，并检验PPS、Neyman与简单随机抽样在LSTM序列训练中的效率差异，同时评估价格与远期IV的可预测性及活动时钟对收益率分布的影响。
cards.descriptionEn: Using an NVDA equity and options panel, the study compares stratified and liquidity-weighted PPS sampling for implied volatility surface reconstruction, tests PPS, Neyman and simple random sampling for LSTM training efficiency, and evaluates predictability of prices and forward IV along with activity-clock effects on return distributions.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes from a single split-adjusted NVDA panel over 2018–2025, so extrapolation to other assets or markets requires caution. Forward IV mean-reversion is insignificant under session-clustered tests and sequence models do not beat the linear benchmark, so predictability findings are descriptive rather than confirmed. Incremental predictive gains of PPS over simple random sampling are not established.
cards.summaryEn: The work combines finite-population survey sampling, tempered inverse-probability sequence learning and causal activity clocks to reconstruct and forecast implied volatility surfaces on a split-adjusted NVDA panel. Sampling design matching the target functional drives cross-sectional accuracy, while short-horizon prices do not beat a random walk with drift and forward IV mean-reversion appears only in a few post-shock sessions and is insignificant under clustered tests. Activity clocks are presented as descriptive stabilizers of sampling cadence rather than confirmed improvements.
cards.title: 期权隐含波动率曲面的抽样编译与预测方法研究
cards.whyItMattersEn: For quantitative research, the study indicates that surface compilation sampling must align with the downstream target functional or error is systematically inflated, and it sets cautious boundaries on predictive claims—complex sequence models may not beat simple linear benchmarks, and evaluation should account for clustering.
cards.titleEn: Sampling-Based Compilation and Forecasting of Implied Volatility Surfaces
keyPointsEn: Plug-in stratified allocation using lagged cell dispersion improves equal-weighted surface reconstruction with full grid coverage, whereas liquidity-weighted PPS inflates error when misapplied to that target.

PPS and Neyman designs retain more tail-volatility windows in LSTM training and are equivalent to full-census training within chosen margins while cutting training time, but incremental forecasting gains over simple random sampling are not established.

Short-horizon prices do not beat a random walk with drift; forward IV mean-reversion is concentrated in a few post-shock reversal sessions, insignificant under session-clustered tests, and sequence models do not outperform a linear HAR-IV benchmark.
keyPoints: 分层配置按滞后单元格离散度分配可提升等权曲面重建并覆盖全网格，而流动性加权PPS在错配目标时反而放大误差。
PPS与Neyman设计在LSTM训练中保留更多尾部波动窗口，并在设定容差内与全量训练等效、缩短训练时间，但相对简单随机抽样的增量预测优势未被证实。
短期价格未超越带漂移随机游走，远期IV的均值回复集中在少数冲击后反转时段且按交易时段聚类检验不显著，序列模型未胜过线性HAR-IV基准。
cards.originalTitle: Compiling and forecasting implied volatility surfaces via survey sampling, tempered inverse-probability sequence learning, and causal activity clocks

cards.whyItMatters: 该研究为可转债次日价格预测提供了一个严格的持续性基准，提示在缺乏同期权益市场信息或合约事件条件时，跨债深度面板学习难以带来可靠的样本外增量预测力，有助于避免对复杂模型样本内拟合或排序结果的过度解读。
cards.summary: 论文使用2022至2025年100只A股可转债的73,806条日度面板数据，在严格时间分割、边界清洗、折内预处理和依赖感知推断下评估跨债神经架构的次日价格预测能力。事实是：在29,514条留出样本上，随机游走RMSE为2.3577元，五种子集成的小型与大型价格变化MLP的RMSE分别为2.3619和2.3645元，样本外R^2为负，HAC p值不显著，块自举区间跨零。作者观点是：在没有同期权益市场信息或明确合约事件条件的情况下，深度面板架构不能提供超越持续性的增量次日可预测性。
cards.limitations: 结论基于2022至2025年100只A股可转债的日度面板，未纳入同期权益市场信息或显式合约事件条件；仅评估了特定MLP架构与集成方式，未覆盖其他潜在模型结构；样本外结果依赖于所采用的时间分割、边界清洗和推断方法；研究不构成任何投资建议。
cards.description: 该研究在严格时间分割与依赖感知推断下检验跨债神经网络能否超越随机游走，发现小/大价格变化MLP集成在次日价格预测上未优于持续性基准，且直接训练价格水平会显著恶化性能。
cards.descriptionEn: The study tests whether cross-bond neural networks beat a random walk under strict temporal splitting and dependence-aware inference, finding that small and large price-change MLP ensembles do not outperform persistence in next-day price forecasting, and that direct price-level training degrades performance substantially.
cards.limitationsEn: The conclusions are based on a daily panel of 100 A-share convertible bonds from 2022 to 2025, without incorporating contemporaneous equity market information or explicit contractual event conditioning; only specific MLP architectures and ensemble methods are evaluated, not other potential model structures; out-of-sample results depend on the temporal splitting, boundary purging, and inference methods used; the study does not constitute investment advice.
cards.summaryEn: Using a daily panel of 73,806 observations across 100 A-share convertible bonds from 2022 to 2025, the paper evaluates cross-bond neural architectures for next-day price forecasting under strict temporal splitting, boundary purging, fold-specific preprocessing, and dependence-aware inference. The facts are: on the 29,514-observation holdout, the random walk achieves an RMSE of 2.3577 CNY, while five-seed ensembles of small and large price-change MLPs yield RMSEs of 2.3619 and 2.3645 CNY, with negative out-of-sample R^2 values and non-significant HAC p-values, and block-bootstrap intervals spanning zero. The authors' view is that without contemporaneous equity market information or explicit contractual event conditioning, deep panel architectures do not deliver incremental next-day predictability over persistence.
cards.title: 中国可转债跨债面板学习次日价格预测的实证检验
cards.whyItMattersEn: The study provides a rigorous persistence benchmark for next-day convertible bond price forecasting, suggesting that cross-bond deep panel learning may not yield reliable out-of-sample incremental predictive power without contemporaneous equity market information or contractual event conditioning, and helping avoid overinterpretation of in-sample fit or ranking results from complex models.
cards.titleEn: A Reality Check on Cross-Bond Panel Learning for Next-Day Price Forecasting of Chinese Convertible Bonds
keyPointsEn: The random walk achieves an RMSE of 2.3577 CNY on the holdout, while five-seed ensembles of small and large price-change MLPs yield RMSEs of 2.3619 and 2.3645 CNY, with negative out-of-sample R^2 values (-0.0035 and -0.0057).
Target-date clustered HAC p-values are 0.453 and 0.248, and ten-day circular block-bootstrap intervals span zero, so the null of no advantage is not rejected.

Cross-bond pooling lowers test RMSE for 79 of 90 individual bonds, showing a variance-stabilizing shrinkage effect, but fails to produce an aggregate forecast advantage; five highly volatile, clause-sensitive bonds account for 74.4% of the model's total excess squared error.
Direct price-level training degrades performance substantially.
keyPoints: 随机游走在留出集上的RMSE为2.3577元，小/大价格变化MLP五种子集成的RMSE分别为2.3619和2.3645元，样本外R^2为负（-0.0035和-0.0057）。
目标日聚类HAC p值为0.453和0.248，十日循环块自举区间跨零，未拒绝无优势的原假设。
跨债池化对90只债券中的79只降低了测试RMSE，呈现方差稳定收缩效应，但未产生总体预测优势；五只高波动、条款敏感债券贡献了74.4%的总超额平方误差。
直接训练价格水平会显著恶化性能。
cards.originalTitle: Cross-Bond Panel Learning for Next-Day Price Forecasting of Chinese Convertible Bonds: A Reality Check

cards.whyItMatters: 对于依赖历史数据与回测的量化研究工具，日期解析错误可能导致信息泄露，使回测结果偏乐观；决策评分与结算规则的修正则影响回测时序的准确性。这些修复有助于提高基于 TradingAgents 进行策略模拟与评估时的数据一致性和可信度，但版本说明未涉及策略收益或模型效果的量化变化。
cards.summary: TradingAgents 发布 v0.7.1 版本，主要修复了模型传入未补零日期（如 2024-7-5）时可能读取运行日期之后提交的 SEC 文件的问题，并确保决策只基于已收盘的 K 线评分，且在超过一周的休市后恢复交易时完成结算。此外，版本还修复了投资组合中标的名称匹配、价格有效数字保留、SEC 报表按期间单行展示、回测失败上报及运行隔离等多项缺陷。发布说明列举了具体修复项与贡献者，未提供性能提升或投资效果的量化结论。
cards.limitations: 发布说明仅列出缺陷修复，未提供任何实验数据、性能基准或投资效果评估，无法据此判断修复对策略收益或模型准确性的实际影响。部分修复（如 .env 文件移除）涉及部署配置变更，需要用户手动调整。所列问题是否彻底解决及是否引入新问题，仍需独立验证。
cards.description: 该版本修复了模型未补零日期导致读取未来财报的问题，并调整决策评分逻辑，使其不再基于交易中的K线且能跨长假正确结算；同时修正投资组合匹配、价格精度、SEC数据按季展示等多项缺陷，提升了回测与数据读取的准确性。
cards.descriptionEn: This release fixes an issue where unpadded dates from the model could read future filings, adjusts decision scoring to avoid in-progress bars and settle after long market closures, and corrects portfolio matching, price precision, SEC statement alignment, and other defects to improve backtest and data-reading accuracy.
cards.limitationsEn: The release notes only list bug fixes and provide no experimental data, performance benchmarks, or investment outcome evaluations, so the actual impact of the fixes on strategy returns or model accuracy cannot be judged. Some fixes (e.g., removal of .env files) involve deployment configuration changes requiring manual adjustment. Whether the listed issues are fully resolved and whether new issues are introduced still require independent verification.
cards.summaryEn: TradingAgents released v0.7.1, primarily fixing a bug where unpadded dates (e.g., 2024-7-5) could cause the model to read SEC filings filed after the run date, and ensuring decisions are scored only on closed bars and settle when trading resumes after a closure longer than a week. The release also fixes portfolio instrument matching, price significant digits, SEC statement one-row-per-period display, backtest failure reporting, run isolation, and other issues. The notes list specific fixes and contributors but provide no quantitative conclusions on performance or investment outcomes.
cards.title: TradingAgents v0.7.1 修复日期解析与跨长假结算
cards.whyItMattersEn: For quantitative research tools relying on historical data and backtesting, date parsing errors can cause information leakage and overly optimistic backtest results; the fixes to decision scoring and settlement rules affect the temporal accuracy of backtests. These fixes help improve data consistency and credibility when using TradingAgents for strategy simulation and evaluation, but the release notes do not quantify changes in strategy returns or model performance.
cards.titleEn: TradingAgents v0.7.1 Fixes Date Parsing and Settlement Across Long Holidays
keyPointsEn: Fixes unpadded date parsing to prevent the model from reading SEC filings filed after the run date.
Decision scoring no longer uses bars from a session still trading, and settles after long holiday closures.
Fixes portfolio matching, price display precision, SEC statement period alignment, and backtest run isolation.
Docker images no longer include .env files; Azure OpenAI keys must be configured via .env.
keyPoints: 修复未补零日期解析漏洞，避免模型读取运行日期之后的 SEC 文件。
决策评分不再使用仍在交易中的 K 线，并在长假休市后自动结算。
修复投资组合匹配、价格显示精度、SEC 报表期间对齐及回测运行隔离等多项问题。
Docker 镜像不再包含 .env 文件，Azure OpenAI 密钥需通过 .env 配置。

cards.whyItMatters: 该方法提供了一种量化手段，用于判断学习到的决策是否实现了其声明的金融目标，从而将奖励设定错误与学习误差分离，有助于提高金融强化学习应用的可信度。
cards.summary: 在金融强化学习中，智能体可能准确优化一个加性风险调整奖励，却执行了不同的金融偏好。作者开发了一种针对终端均值-方差均衡的决策审计，利用演员、奖励和延续评论家残差来界定改变单个动作的收益上限。实验表明，该方法能减少策略距离和单步偏离收益，但联合奖励校准并未改善实际投资表现。
cards.limitations: 研究基于有限外生状态市场的终端均值-方差均衡框架，证书的有效性依赖于该均衡假设；实验仅限于九个受控市场和特定美国行业投资组合，未覆盖更广泛的市场条件或资产类别；回测结果基于历史数据，不代表未来表现。
cards.description: 该研究提出一种决策审计方法，用于分离奖励设定错误与学习误差，从而量化学习到的决策是否真正实现了声明的金融目标，而非仅优化了奖励数值。
cards.descriptionEn: This study proposes a decision audit method to separate reward misspecification from learning error, quantifying whether a learned decision truly implements its stated financial objective rather than merely optimizing a reward value.
cards.limitationsEn: The study is based on a terminal mean-variance equilibrium framework in finite exogenous-state markets, and the certificate's validity relies on this equilibrium assumption; experiments are limited to nine controlled markets and specific US industry portfolios, not covering broader market conditions or asset classes; backtest results are based on historical data and do not represent future performance.
cards.summaryEn: In financial reinforcement learning, an agent may accurately optimize an additive risk-adjusted reward yet implement a different financial preference. The authors develop a decision audit for terminal mean-variance equilibrium that bounds the gain from changing one action using actor, reward, and continuation-critic residuals. Experiments show the method reduces policy distance and one-step deviation gain, but joint reward calibration does not improve realized investment performance.
cards.title: 投资组合强化学习中的奖励对齐证书
cards.whyItMattersEn: The method provides a quantitative means to assess whether a learned decision implements its stated financial objective, separating reward misspecification from learning error, which can enhance the credibility of financial reinforcement learning applications.
cards.titleEn: Certifying Reward Alignment in Portfolio Reinforcement Learning
keyPointsEn: A certificate is proposed that bounds the gain from changing one action using actor, reward, and continuation-critic residuals, ignoring state-constant critic offsets and accommodating convex action constraints.
Across nine controlled markets and twenty seeds, a continuation-aware actor-critic method reduces policy distance and one-step deviation gain.

In backtests over 432 months with seven covariance estimators and 10, 30, and 49 US industry portfolios, joint reward calibration preserves fitted mean-variance targets but does not improve realized investment performance.
keyPoints: 提出一种证书，利用演员、奖励和延续评论家残差来界定改变单个动作的收益，忽略状态常数评论家偏移并适应凸动作约束。
在九个受控市场和二十个随机种子中，延续感知的演员-评论家方法降低了策略距离和单步偏离收益。
在432个月、7个协方差估计器和10、30、49个美国行业投资组合的回测中，联合奖励校准保持了拟合的均值-方差目标，但未改善实际投资表现。
cards.originalTitle: Certifying Reward Alignment in Portfolio Reinforcement Learning

cards.whyItMatters: 为语音代理从“听完再行动”转向“边听边行动”提供了数据驱动路径，有望降低工具调用延迟，提升实时交互体验。
cards.summary: 论文指出延迟敏感的语音代理需在听够信息时立即调用工具，而非等待回合结束。作者构建了含最早可行动点标注的合成语音对话数据集，并训练全模态模型进行因果分块决策。实验显示模型在域内和外部基准上分别达到0.48和0.47的工具状态宏F1，正确调用时平均领先回合结束级联1.8-2.0秒和1.1秒。
cards.limitations: 性能基于合成语音数据集和单一模型配置，宏F1仅约0.48，绝对精度有限；外部评估仅使用τ²-bench音频版本，未涵盖真实场景多样性；提前量估计依赖相同格式化器，未与更多基线比较；训练与测试参数值不相交，但未报告跨领域泛化细节。
cards.description: 提出一种合成语音对话数据管线，为工具调用提供最早可行动点监督，并训练全模态语言模型实现分块级在线决策，从而在用户说完前提前执行工具调用。
cards.descriptionEn: Introduces a synthetic spoken-dialogue pipeline that provides earliest-actionable-point supervision and trains an omni-modal language model for chunk-level causal decisions, enabling tool calls before the user finishes speaking.
cards.limitationsEn: Performance is based on a synthetic speech dataset and a single model configuration, with macro-F1 around 0.48 indicating limited absolute accuracy; external evaluation uses only the audio rendering of τ²-bench and does not cover real-world diversity; lead estimates rely on the same formatter and lack comparison with more baselines; train/test argument values are disjoint but cross-domain generalization details are not reported.
cards.summaryEn: The paper argues that latency-sensitive spoken agents should call tools as soon as enough information is heard, rather than waiting for turn completion. The authors construct a synthetic spoken dialogue dataset with earliest-actionable-point annotations and train an omni-modal model for causal chunk-level decisions. Experiments show tool-state macro-F1 of 0.48 and 0.47 on held-out dialogues and an external benchmark, with mean lead over a turn-end cascade of 1.8-2.0 seconds and 1.1 seconds for correct calls, respectively.
cards.title: 语音对话系统实现边听边调用工具
cards.whyItMattersEn: Provides a data-driven path for spoken agents to move from 'listen-then-act' to 'act-while-listening,' potentially reducing tool-call latency and improving real-time interaction.
cards.titleEn: Early Tool Calling in Spoken Dialogue Systems
keyPointsEn: Constructs a synthetic spoken dialogue dataset of 26,694 dialogues (786 hours) across 48 domains with earliest-actionable-point supervision.
Trains an omni-modal language model for causal chunk-level tool-state decisions and partial-transcript generation.
Achieves tool-state macro-F1 of 0.48 on held-out dialogues and 0.47 on an external benchmark.
For correct calls, achieves mean lead over a turn-end cascade of 1.8-2.0 seconds in-domain and 1.1 seconds on the external benchmark.
keyPoints: 构建26,694段对话、786小时、48个领域的合成语音数据集，提供最早可行动点监督。
训练全模态语言模型，支持因果分块级工具状态决策和部分转录生成。
在留出对话和外部基准上工具状态宏F1分别为0.48和0.47。
正确调用时，相比回合结束级联平均提前1.8-2.0秒（域内）和1.1秒（外部基准）。
cards.originalTitle: Heard Enough to Act: Early Tool Calling in Spoken Dialogue Systems

cards.whyItMatters: 为LLM利用图结构外部知识（如学术索引、产品目录）提供了可迁移的交互能力训练方法，表明学到的图探索与推理能力可跨领域泛化，有助于提升复杂多跳问答的事实性与效率。
cards.summary: 论文研究LLM如何学习在异构图上进行多跳证据聚合和精确函数调用，并迁移到未见领域。作者提出GraphDancer强化学习框架，结合图感知课程（按问题结构难度从易到难采样）训练中等规模LLM。在GRBench多领域基准上，仅用学术和生物医学图训练，模型在留出问题和未见领域均优于同底座图代理基线，轨迹分析显示其更常检索到答案证据且无效协议结果减少。
cards.limitations: 证据基于GRBench基准上的实验，训练仅限学术和生物医学两个领域，未见领域测试覆盖电商、文学、法律三类图；结论是否适用于其他图模式、更大规模模型或真实生产环境尚未验证。轨迹分析为观察性结果，未建立因果机制。
cards.description: 提出GraphDancer框架，通过强化学习让LLM在异构图上交替进行推理与函数调用，并引入图感知课程按结构难度安排训练。实验显示，仅用学术和生物医学图训练后，模型在未见电商、文学、法律图上仍优于同底座基线，14B版本在未见领域平均超越GPT-4.1-mini和GPT-5-nano驱动的基线。
cards.descriptionEn: GraphDancer is a reinforcement learning framework that trains LLMs to interleave reasoning with function calls over heterogeneous graphs, using a graph-aware curriculum that schedules questions by structural difficulty. Trained only on academic and biomedical graphs, it outperforms same-backbone graph-agent baselines on held-out and unseen e-commerce, literature, and legal graphs; the 14B variant also surpasses baselines powered by GPT-4.1-mini and GPT-5-nano on average acros
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is based on experiments on the GRBench benchmark, with training limited to academic and biomedical domains and unseen-domain testing covering e-commerce, literature, and legal graphs. Whether the conclusions hold for other graph schemas, larger models, or production settings is not verified. Trajectory analyses are observational and do not establish causal mechanisms.
cards.summaryEn: The paper studies how LLMs can learn multi-hop evidence aggregation and precise function calling over heterogeneous graphs and transfer these skills to unseen domains. The authors propose GraphDancer, an RL framework with a graph-aware easy-to-hard curriculum for moderate-sized LLMs. On the multi-domain GRBench benchmark, training only on academic and biomedical graphs yields gains over same-backbone graph-agent baselines on held-out and unseen domains, with trajectory analyses showing more frequent retrieval of answer-bearing evidence and fewer invalid-protocol outcomes.
cards.title: GraphDancer：用课程强化学习训练LLM探索图结构知识
cards.whyItMattersEn: It offers a transferable training approach for LLMs to interact with graph-structured external knowledge such as scholarly indexes and product catalogs, showing that learned graph exploration and reasoning can generalize across domains and support complex multi-hop question answering.
cards.titleEn: GraphDancer: Training LLMs to Explore and Reason over Graph-Structured Knowledge via Curriculum Reinforcement Learning
keyPointsEn: GraphDancer teaches LLMs to interleave reasoning with function execution over graphs rather than relying only on similarity-based retrieval.
A graph-aware curriculum samples questions from easy to hard by structural difficulty to improve RL training for moderate-sized LLMs.

Trained only on academic and biomedical graphs, it outperforms same-backbone baselines on unseen e-commerce, literature, and legal graphs, and the 14B variant exceeds GPT-4.1-mini and GPT-5-nano powered baselines on average across unseen domains.
keyPoints: GraphDancer让LLM在图上交替推理与执行函数调用，而非仅依赖相似度检索。
图感知课程按问题结构难度从易到难采样，以改善中等规模LLM的强化学习训练。
仅用学术和生物医学图训练，在未见电商、文学、法律图上仍优于同底座基线，14B版本平均超越GPT-4.1-mini和GPT-5-nano驱动的基线。
cards.originalTitle: GraphDancer: Training LLMs to Explore and Reason over Graphs via Curriculum Reinforcement Learning

cards.whyItMatters: 若周末加密货币波动对周一传统市场方差具有预测信息，则可为跨市场风险管理与波动率建模提供新的日历特定指标，并提示聚合关联测度可能遗漏此类信息。
cards.summary: 论文利用2017-2026年日度区间方差数据，在HAR模型中加入周末加密货币共同因子，发现2024年前预测力弱，2024年后显著。作者报告：因子每增加一个标准差，周一拟合方差提高27-54%；样本外QLIKE损失降低11-22%，但统计证据因市场而异。作者认为日历特定波动率测度可能揭示聚合关联测度所掩盖的预测信息，但ETF流量交互未提供放大证据，机制未解。
cards.limitations: 预测力仅在2024年后样本显著，样本外改善的统计证据因市场而异；机制未明确，ETF流量交互未提供放大证据；结构断点估计为2023年末，但因果解释有限；结果基于特定资产与模型设定，不宜直接外推为投资建议。
cards.description: 该研究检验周末加密货币波动能否预测周一股票、商品和固定收益市场的方差，发现2024年后预测能力显著增强，且共同因子优于币种特定信息，但机制尚未明确。
cards.descriptionEn: This study examines whether weekend cryptocurrency volatility predicts Monday variance in equity, commodity, and fixed-income markets, finding that predictive content strengthens significantly after 2024, with a common factor outperforming coin-specific information, though the mechanism remains unresolved.
cards.limitationsEn: Predictive power is significant only in the post-2024 sample, and out-of-sample improvements have varying statistical evidence across markets; the mechanism is unresolved, with ETF-flow interactions providing no evidence of amplification; the structural break is estimated in late 2023 but causal interpretation is limited; results are based on specific assets and model specifications and should not be directly extrapolated as investment advice.
cards.summaryEn: Using daily range-based variance measures from 2017 to 2026, the paper augments heterogeneous autoregressive models with a common weekend cryptocurrency factor and finds weak predictive content before 2024 but significant predictive content thereafter. The authors report that a one-standard-deviation increase in the factor is associated with 27-54% higher fitted Monday variance and reduces out-of-sample QLIKE losses by 11-22%, although statistical evidence varies across markets. The authors suggest that calendar-specific volatility measures may reveal predictive information obscured by aggregate connectedness measures, but ETF-flow interactions provide no evidence of amplification, leaving the mechanism unresolved.
cards.title: 周末加密货币波动对周一市场风险预测力增强
cards.whyItMattersEn: If weekend cryptocurrency volatility carries predictive information for Monday traditional market variance, it could provide a new calendar-specific indicator for cross-market risk management and volatility modeling, and suggest that aggregate connectedness measures may miss such information.
cards.titleEn: Weekend Crypto Volatility Predicts Monday Market Risk More Strongly After 2024
keyPointsEn: After 2024, the common weekend cryptocurrency factor significantly predicts Monday variance, with a one-standard-deviation increase associated with 27-54% higher fitted Monday variance.
Adding the factor reduces out-of-sample QLIKE losses by 11-22%, but statistical significance varies across markets.

Friday cryptocurrency volatility does not reproduce the result, coin-specific variation adds no significant information beyond the common factor, and although a structural break is estimated in late 2023, ETF-flow interactions show no amplification effect.
keyPoints: 2024年后，周末加密货币共同因子对周一方差有显著预测力，因子每增加一个标准差，拟合周一方差提高27-54%。
加入该因子使样本外QLIKE损失降低11-22%，但统计显著性因市场不同而异。
周五加密货币波动不能复现该结果，币种特定变异在共同因子之外无显著增量信息；2023年末估计存在结构断点，但ETF流量交互未显示放大效应。
cards.originalTitle: Weekend Crypto Volatility and Monday Market Risk

cards.whyItMatters: 金融交易网络天然具有多图结构，反洗钱检测模型若易受结构扰动攻击，可能导致漏报。该工作揭示了多图神经网络的脆弱性，并提供对抗训练作为防御手段，对提升金融犯罪检测系统的安全性具有参考价值。
cards.summary: 事实：论文提出了基于节点-边关联矩阵的结构攻击与对抗训练框架，适配投影梯度下降和投影随机块坐标下降方法，并引入惩罚有向2环和3环全局计数变化的循环正则项。在合成模式检测和真实反洗钱数据集上，学习到的攻击比不可学习的扰动基线更能降低检测性能（PR-AUC），对抗训练则持续提升鲁棒性。作者观点：多图神经网络对学习到的结构攻击存在脆弱性，对抗训练是一种有效防御手段。
cards.limitations: 研究基于合成模式检测和真实反洗钱数据集，攻击与防御效果可能受数据集特性和攻击假设限制；循环正则项仅考虑有向2环和3环，未覆盖更复杂的结构模式；对抗训练的计算开销和在大规模动态网络中的适用性未充分讨论；结论不构成投资建议。
cards.description: 该研究首次提出针对多图神经网络的可扩展结构攻击与对抗训练框架，利用节点-边关联矩阵优化结构扰动，并引入基于循环的正则项衡量攻击合理性。实验表明，学习到的攻击能显著降低反洗钱检测性能，而对抗训练可有效提升鲁棒性。
cards.descriptionEn: This study presents the first scalable framework for structural attacks and adversarial training on multigraph neural networks, optimizing structural perturbations via node-edge incidence matrices and introducing a cycle-based regularizer to measure attack plausibility. Experiments show that learned attacks significantly degrade anti-money laundering detection performance, while adversarial training effectively improves robustness.
cards.limitationsEn: The study is based on synthetic pattern-detection and realistic AML datasets; attack and defense effects may be limited by dataset characteristics and attack assumptions. The cycle-based regularizer only considers directed 2- and 3-cycles, not more complex structural patterns. Computational overhead of adversarial training and applicability to large-scale dynamic networks are not fully discussed. Conclusions do not constitute investment advice.
cards.summaryEn: Fact: The paper proposes a structural attack and adversarial training framework based on node-edge incidence matrices, adapting projected gradient descent and projected randomized block coordinate descent, and introduces a cycle-based regularizer penalizing changes in global counts of directed 2- and 3-cycles. On synthetic pattern-detection and realistic AML datasets, learned attacks substantially outperform non-learnable perturbation baselines in reducing detection performance (PR-AUC), and adversarial training consistently improves robustness. Author's view: Multigraph neural networks are vulnerable to learned structural attacks, and adversarial training provides an effective defense.
cards.title: 多图神经网络抵御结构攻击的对抗训练框架
cards.whyItMattersEn: Financial transaction networks are naturally multigraphs, and vulnerable anti-money laundering models may lead to missed detections under structural attacks. This work reveals the vulnerability of multigraph neural networks and offers adversarial training as a defense, providing reference value for improving the security of financial crime detection systems.
cards.titleEn: Adversarially Robust Multigraph Neural Networks for Financial Crime Analysis
keyPointsEn: Proposes the first scalable framework for structural attacks and adversarial training on multigraph neural networks, optimizing perturbations over node-edge incidence matrices.
Introduces a cycle-based regularizer penalizing changes in global counts of directed 2- and 3-cycles as a structural measure of attack plausibility.
Experiments show learned attacks significantly reduce PR-AUC, and adversarial training consistently improves model robustness.
keyPoints: 提出首个面向多图神经网络的可扩展结构攻击与对抗训练框架，基于节点-边关联矩阵优化扰动。
引入循环正则项惩罚有向2环和3环全局计数的变化，作为攻击合理性的结构度量。
实验显示学习到的攻击显著降低PR-AUC，对抗训练能持续提升模型鲁棒性。
cards.originalTitle: Towards Adversarially Robust Multigraph Neural Networks for Financial Crime Analysis

cards.whyItMatters: 该工作为农业场景中遮挡目标的自动检测提供了可复用的标注与部署方案，降低标注成本并验证了边缘设备在户外移动部署中的可行性，有助于推动收获后质量检测的自动化。
cards.summary: 针对甜菜收获后质量检测中甜菜根重叠遮挡导致标注和检测困难的问题，作者提出端到端图像检测流水线并构建专用基准。他们利用SAM 3基础模型自动生成边界框标签，与手动标注训练的模型对比，并评估包括Raspberry Pi 5搭配Hailo加速器在内的边缘部署配置。实验表明，基础模型标签可在小幅精度损失下替代大量手动标注，且边缘设备能实现高性能低功耗推理。
cards.limitations: 证据边界限于作者构建的专用基准和特定装载场景，自动标注的精度损失程度及边缘配置的功耗与推理时间结论可能受硬件、模型和数据集影响，未涉及大规模田间验证或其他作物。
cards.description: 该研究提出端到端图像流水线检测装载场景中部分遮挡的甜菜根，引入专用基准和基于SAM 3的自动标注策略，并比较手动与自动标签训练的模型，同时基准测试多种推理配置（包括边缘设备）在精度、推理时间和功耗方面的表现。
cards.descriptionEn: This study presents an end-to-end image pipeline for detecting partially occluded sugar beets in loading scenarios, introduces a dedicated benchmark and an automatic annotation strategy using SAM 3, compares models trained on manual versus automatically generated labels, and benchmarks multiple inference configurations including edge devices under realistic constraints of precision, inference time, and power consumption.
cards.limitationsEn: The evidence is limited to the authors' dedicated benchmark and specific loading scenarios; the extent of accuracy loss from automatic labeling and conclusions about power consumption and inference time may depend on hardware, model, and dataset, with no large-scale field validation or other crops addressed.
cards.summaryEn: To address annotation and detection challenges caused by overlapping and occluded sugar beets during post-harvest quality inspection, the authors propose an end-to-end image detection pipeline and construct a dedicated benchmark. They use the SAM 3 foundation model to automatically generate bounding box labels, compare models trained on manual and automatic labels, and evaluate edge deployment configurations including a Raspberry Pi 5 with a Hailo accelerator. Results show that foundation-model labels can substitute for a substantial share of manual annotation at a modest accuracy cost, and that the edge device enables high-performance, low-power inference.
cards.title: 甜菜根检测的边缘部署与基准测试
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work provides a reusable annotation and deployment approach for detecting occluded objects in agricultural settings, reduces labeling costs, and demonstrates the feasibility of edge devices for mobile outdoor deployment, supporting automation of post-harvest quality inspection.
cards.titleEn: Edge Deployment and Benchmarking of Beet-Root Detection Models
keyPointsEn: Proposes an end-to-end image pipeline for detecting partially occluded sugar beets and releases a dedicated benchmark.
Uses SAM 3 to automatically generate bounding box labels, which can replace a substantial share of manual annotation with a modest accuracy drop.
A Raspberry Pi 5 with a Hailo accelerator achieves high-performance, low-power inference under realistic constraints.
keyPoints: 提出基于图像检测部分遮挡甜菜根的端到端流水线，并发布专用基准。
利用SAM 3自动生成边界框标签，可替代相当比例手动标注，精度略有下降。
Raspberry Pi 5搭配Hailo加速器在真实约束下实现高性能低功耗推理。
cards.originalTitle: RootDown: Deploying and Benchmarking Models for Beet-Root Detection on Edge Devices

cards.whyItMatters: 若项目按描述落地，多模型智能体可从单次问答转向共享文件与任务的持续协作，减少人工在模型间搬运上下文的工作，并为本地部署的多智能体工作流提供可参考的开源实现。
cards.summary: Openbot 是一个本地优先的桌面工作区，用于承载可长期运行的 AI 智能体团队。项目描述称可运行 Codex、Claude、Grok，并提供专用工作区、任务队列、文件共享、浏览器控制及智能体间协作。以上均来自项目自述，尚无独立评测或文档细节支撑。
cards.limitations: 信息仅来自 GitHub Trending 的项目简介，缺少安装文档、代码成熟度、实际性能、资源占用和安全边界的验证；不构成投资或采购建议，使用前需自行审查代码与许可证。
cards.description: Openbot 是 GitHub 上出现的本地优先桌面工作区项目，核心新意在于把 Codex、Claude、Grok 等模型放进各自独立工作区，并通过任务队列、文件共享、浏览器控制和智能体间协作组成持续运行的 AI 团队；对需要多模型协同且重视本地运行的研究者与开发者有参考价值。
cards.descriptionEn: Openbot is a local-first desktop workspace project on GitHub. Its novelty lies in placing Codex, Claude, and Grok in dedicated workspaces and connecting them through task queues, file sharing, browser control, and agent-to-agent collaboration to form a persistent AI team. It is relevant to researchers and developers who need multi-model coordination with a local-first emphasis.
cards.limitationsEn: Information comes only from the GitHub Trending project blurb; there is no verification of installation docs, code maturity, real-world performance, resource usage, or security boundaries. This is not investment or procurement advice; review the code and license before use.
cards.summaryEn: Openbot is a local-first desktop workspace for hosting persistent AI agent teams. The project describes running Codex, Claude, and Grok with dedicated workspaces, task queues, file sharing, browser control, and agent-to-agent collaboration. These claims come from the project's own description and are not yet backed by independent reviews or detailed documentation.
cards.title: Openbot 推出本地优先多智能体桌面工作区
cards.whyItMattersEn: If delivered as described, multi-model agents could move beyond single-turn Q&A to ongoing collaboration over shared files and tasks, reducing manual context transfer between models and providing an open-source reference for locally deployed multi-agent workflows.
cards.titleEn: Openbot Launches a Local-First Multi-Agent Desktop Workspace
keyPointsEn: Positioned as a local-first desktop workspace for running AI agents locally.
Supports multiple models including Codex, Claude, and Grok, with a dedicated workspace per agent.
Feature set includes task queues, file sharing, browser control, and agent-to-agent collaboration.
keyPoints: 定位为本地优先的桌面工作区，强调在本地环境运行 AI 智能体。
支持 Codex、Claude、Grok 等多种模型，并为每个智能体分配专用工作区。
功能组合包括任务队列、文件共享、浏览器控制和智能体间协作。

cards.whyItMatters: 为社媒运营者提供开源可自托管的智能排程方案，降低对商业 SaaS 工具的依赖，并推动代理式自动化在内容管理中的实践。

cards.limitations: 来源仅为 GitHub 趋势榜的项目自述，未提供功能细节、性能指标或实际使用案例；开源项目成熟度与稳定性未经证实；不构成采用或投资建议。
cards.description: Postiz 是一个开源智能体社交媒体排程工具，通过 AI 代理实现自动排程。它的新意在于将代理式自动化引入社媒管理，为开源社区提供可自托管的替代方案。
cards.descriptionEn: Postiz is an open-source agentic social media scheduling tool that automates scheduling via AI agents. Its novelty lies in introducing agentic automation to social media management, offering a self-hostable alternative for the open-source community.
cards.limitationsEn: The source is only the project's self-description on GitHub Trending, with no functional details, performance metrics, or actual use cases provided; the maturity and stability of the open-source project are unverified; this does not constitute adoption or investment advice.
cards.summaryEn: Postiz is a GitHub trending project that describes itself as the ultimate agentic social media scheduling tool. It represents an open-source attempt to bring agentic automation to social media management tools. These facts are based on the project's self-description and trending status; specific features and performance should be verified against the code repository.
cards.title: 开源智能体社媒排程工具Postiz
cards.whyItMattersEn: It provides social media operators with an open-source, self-hostable intelligent scheduling solution, reducing reliance on commercial SaaS tools and promoting the practice of agentic automation in content management.

keyPointsEn: Positioned as an agentic social media scheduling tool
Offers a self-hostable option as open source

cards.whyItMatters: 对于 AI 工程从业者，该议程集中反映了从模型能力到生产系统落地的多个工程环节，包括 harness 优化、合成数据、智能体记忆与安全等，可作为了解行业讨论方向的参考信息。
cards.summary: 事实层面：DeepLearning.AI 发布 AI Dev NYC 会议信息，时间为 2026 年 11 月 30 日至 12 月 1 日，地点为纽约 Chelsea Piers，包含 OpenAI、Hugging Face、Andrew Ng、Yann LeCun 等讲者与两天的技术演讲和研讨会。作者/主办方观点层面：该活动将上述议题定位为 AI 工程技能与生产系统可靠性的关键方向。
cards.limitations: 该内容仅为会议宣传短讯，未提供任何演讲内容、技术细节、实验数据或结论；所列讲者与议题以主办方公布为准，实际议程可能调整；不应据此推断具体技术方案的优劣或形成投资判断。
cards.description: 该内容是一则会议宣传短讯，明确 AI Dev NYC 将于 2026 年 11 月 30 日至 12 月 1 日在纽约 Chelsea Piers 举办，并列出多位讲者与议题方向。它的新意在于集中呈现从模型能力、合成数据与 harness 优化，到知识图谱、智能体记忆、智能体 harness、自改进智能体、推理与安全等工程化话题，对关注 AI 工程落地的从业者具有议程参考价值。
cards.descriptionEn: This is a conference promotional short announcing that AI Dev NYC will take place on November 30–December 1, 2026 at Chelsea Piers, NYC, and listing speakers and topic directions. Its value lies in gathering engineering-oriented topics—from model capabilities, synthetic data, and harness optimization to knowledge graphs, agent memory, agent harnesses, self-improving agents, inference, and security—offering agenda reference for practitioners focused on AI engineering implement
cards.limitationsEn: This content is only a conference promotional short and provides no talk content, technical details, experimental data, or conclusions; listed speakers and topics are subject to the organizer's announcement and the actual agenda may change; it should not be used to infer the superiority of specific technical solutions or to form investment judgments.
cards.summaryEn: Factual level: DeepLearning.AI released information about AI Dev NYC, scheduled for November 30–December 1, 2026 at Chelsea Piers, NYC, featuring speakers from OpenAI, Hugging Face, Andrew Ng, Yann LeCun, and two days of technical talks and workshops. cards.titleEn: AI Dev NYC 2026 Agenda Released: Engineering Skills from Model Capabilities to Production Systems

cards.whyItMatters: 当 AI 生成代码比例上升，人工逐行检查变得不现实，该课程提供可操作的审查流程与工具构建思路，帮助在合并前发现需求遗漏和安全问题，并将审查反馈沉淀为团队标准。
cards.summary: 课程提出七项 AI 代码审查实践，包括在提交 PR 前运行审查、使用未参与编码的审查者、提供任务与仓库上下文、按风险分级处理发现、将有效反馈转化为可复用标准。课程强调，给审查者的上下文比使用哪个模型更重要。学员还将构建包含分块、嵌入、向量检索的上下文引擎，并扩展为专业化审查者集成。
cards.limitations: 来源为课程宣传摘要，未提供七项实践的完整清单、实证数据或效果对比；核心结论“上下文比模型更重要”属于课程观点，缺乏独立验证；未讨论不同编程语言、团队规模或安全场景下的适用性差异。
cards.description: DeepLearning.AI 与 Qodo 合作推出的 AI 代码审查课程，基于七项审查实践与前后对比示例，指出给审查者的上下文比选用哪种模型更重要。该内容帮助团队在 AI 生成代码增多时系统化检查需求遗漏与安全风险，并指导构建自定义审查代理。
cards.descriptionEn: A DeepLearning.AI course built with Qodo presents seven AI code review practices with before-and-after examples, arguing that the context given to the reviewer matters more than which model is used. It helps teams systematically check for missed requirements and security issues as AI-generated code increases, and guides building a custom review agent.
cards.limitationsEn: The source is a course promotional summary and does not provide the full list of seven practices, empirical data, or effect comparisons; the core claim that context matters more than model is a course viewpoint without independent verification; applicability across programming languages, team sizes, or security scenarios is not discussed.
cards.summaryEn: The course proposes seven AI code review practices, including running review before opening a pull request, using a reviewer that did not write the code, providing task and repository context, triaging findings by risk, and turning good feedback into reusable standards. It emphasizes that the context given to the reviewer matters more than the model choice. Learners also build a context engine with chunking, embeddings, and vector search, then extend it into an ensemble of specialized reviewers.
cards.title: AI代码审查的七项实践：上下文比模型更关键
cards.whyItMattersEn: As AI-generated code grows, manual line-by-line checking becomes impractical. The course offers actionable review workflows and agent-building ideas to catch missed requirements and security issues before merging, and to turn review feedback into team standards.
cards.titleEn: Seven AI Code Review Practices: Context Matters More Than Model
keyPointsEn: The seven practices cover review timing, reviewer independence, context provision, risk triage, and feedback reuse.
Core claim: context quality has a greater impact on review effectiveness than model selection.
The course includes building a custom review agent, from a context engine to an ensemble of reviewers.
keyPoints: 七项实践覆盖审查时机、审查者独立性、上下文供给、风险分级与反馈复用。
核心结论：上下文质量对审查效果的影响大于模型选择。
课程包含构建自定义审查代理，从上下文引擎扩展到多审查者集成。

cards.whyItMatters: 若“终身”个性化辅导成立，意味着辅导系统需跨会话记忆学习者状态并持续调整策略，这与一次性问答式工具不同。对开源教育技术社区而言，该项目提供了一个可追踪的实现样本，但价值仍需文档与评测佐证。
cards.summary: DeepTutor 是香港大学数据智能实验室（HKUDS）发布的开源项目，自我定位为终身个性化辅导。项目附带独立主页链接，但当前输入仅给出名称与一句简介。项目是否有效、如何实现个性化，依据现有信息无法判断。
cards.limitations: 输入仅有仓库名称、一句简介和主页链接，没有模型架构、训练数据、评测方法、实验结果或用户研究。无法确认个性化机制、效果、可复现性与适用对象；“终身”是项目宣称的定位，而非已验证结论。
cards.description: 该项目在 GitHub 趋势榜出现，定位为终身个性化辅导，并提供项目主页；输入未包含模型、数据或评测细节，新意在于将辅导从单次交互扩展到长期个性化场景。
cards.descriptionEn: The project appears on GitHub Trending, positioned as lifelong personalized tutoring with a dedicated site; the input lacks model, data and evaluation details, so its novelty lies in extending tutoring beyond one-off interactions.
cards.limitationsEn: The input contains only the repository name, a one-line summary and a homepage link, with no architecture, training data, evaluation method, results or user studies. Personalization mechanisms, effectiveness, reproducibility and target users cannot be confirmed; 'lifelong' is a claimed positioning, not a verified conclusion.
cards.summaryEn: DeepTutor is an open-source project from HKUDS positioned as lifelong personalized tutoring. It links to a dedicated homepage, but the provided input gives only the name and a one-line summary. Whether it works and how personalization is achieved cannot be judged from the available information.
cards.title: DeepTutor 提出终身个性化辅导系统框架
cards.whyItMattersEn: If lifelong personalized tutoring holds, the system must remember learner state across sessions and adapt continuously, unlike one-off Q&A tools. For the open-source edtech community, it offers a trackable implementation sample, though its value still needs documentation and evaluation.
cards.titleEn: DeepTutor Proposes a Lifelong Personalized Tutoring Framework
keyPointsEn: Positioned as lifelong personalized tutoring, emphasizing long-term learning support.
Published under the HKUDS organization on GitHub and listed on GitHub Trending.
Provides a dedicated project homepage at deeptutor.info.
keyPoints: 项目定位为“终身个性化辅导”，强调长期陪伴式学习支持。
出自 HKUDS 组织，托管于 GitHub 并出现在趋势榜。
提供独立项目主页 deeptutor.info 作为信息入口。

cards.whyItMatters: 对于关注量化交易教育的人士，该报道提供了 EPAT 项目毕业生规模、地域分布和优秀项目主题的概览，并呈现从业者关于风险与学习的态度；但它不构成策略有效性或投资决策的依据。
cards.summary: QuantInsti 报道 EPAT 2026 届线上毕业典礼，共有来自 43 个国家的 673 名毕业生（第 63 至 68 批）参加。联合创始人 Nitesh Khandelwal 强调持续学习，EDHEC 教授 Riccardo Rebonato 谈及从危机时刻和伴随风险而来的错误中学习。报道还列出各批次最高分学员与最佳项目。上述理念属于嘉宾观点，报道未提供相关实证检验或策略业绩数据。
cards.limitations: 该内容为毕业典礼活动报道，并非研究论文或实证分析；未提供任何策略的回测、样本外表现或统计检验，嘉宾观点属于个人经验与教育理念，不能据此推断交易表现或投资建议。优秀项目仅列标题，缺少方法细节与结果验证。
cards.description: 该内容报道 QuantInsti EPAT 项目 2026 届线上毕业典礼，涵盖毕业生规模与分布、嘉宾关于从危机和风险错误中学习的观点，以及优秀学员与项目名单。其价值在于呈现量化交易教育社群的活动信息与学习理念，而非提供可验证的市场结论。
cards.descriptionEn: This item reports on the QuantInsti EPAT 2026 online convocation, covering graduate numbers and distribution, guest remarks on learning from crises and risk-taking mistakes, and top scorers and projects. Its value lies in community and educational information rather than verifiable market conclusions.
cards.limitationsEn: This is a convocation event report, not a research paper or empirical analysis; it provides no backtests, out-of-sample performance, or statistical tests. Guest views are personal experience and educational philosophy and cannot be used to infer trading performance or investment advice. Best projects are listed by title only, without methodological details or result validation.
cards.summaryEn: QuantInsti reports the EPAT 2026 online convocation with 673 graduates from 43 countries across Batches 63 to 68. Co-founder Nitesh Khandelwal emphasized continuous learning, and EDHEC professor Riccardo Rebonato spoke about learning from moments of crisis and mistakes that come with taking risk. The report also lists top scorers per batch and best projects. These are guest viewpoints; no empirical tests or strategy performance data are provided.
cards.title: EPAT 2026 毕业典礼：从风险与错误中学习
cards.whyItMattersEn: For those interested in quant trading education, this report offers an overview of EPAT graduate scale, geographic distribution, and outstanding project topics, and presents practitioners' attitudes toward risk and learning; however, it does not constitute evidence of strategy effectiveness or investment advice.
cards.titleEn: EPAT 2026 Convocation: Learning from Risk and Mistakes
keyPointsEn: The EPAT 2026 cohort has 673 graduates from 43 countries, covering Batches 63 to 68.
Guest remarks include continuous learning and learning from crises and risk-related mistakes, expressed as educational philosophy.
The report lists top scorers per batch and two best project topics: using machine learning to predict ICE cotton futures price trends, and trend-following strategies in major currency markets.
keyPoints: EPAT 2026 届共有 673 名毕业生，来自 43 个国家，覆盖第 63 至 68 批。
嘉宾观点包括持续学习以及从危机和风险错误中学习，属于教育理念表达。
报道列出各批次最高分学员及两个最佳项目主题：机器学习预测 ICE 棉花期货价格趋势、主要货币市场趋势跟踪策略。
cards.originalTitle: Every trader makes mistakes. Do you learn from them? | EPAT Convocation 2026
